name: Weather Watch
description: Create a weather watch report for the default location and raise condition-specific alerts for cold, wind, heat, or severe weather.

variables.storm_keywords: thunderstorm, hail, freezing rain, snow, heavy rain
variables.cold_alert_reason: Cold threshold not met or forecast data unavailable.
variables.wind_alert_reason: Wind threshold not met or forecast data unavailable.
variables.heat_alert_reason: Heat threshold not met or forecast data unavailable.
variables.storm_alert_reason: No watched severe weather condition was forecast or forecast data was unavailable.

steps.description: Get current weather and multi-day forecast

params.title: Cold watch for ${resolved_location}
params.description: Forecast low ${forecast_lows[0]}F tonight meets the cold watch threshold of ${cold_threshold_f}F for ${resolved_location}. ${forecast_day_names[0]} ${forecast_dates[0]} high ${forecast_highs[0]}F with ${forecast_conditions[0]}. ${forecast_day_names[1]} ${forecast_dates[1]} low ${forecast_lows[1]}F, high ${forecast_highs[1]}F, condition ${forecast_conditions[1]}. Cover sensitive plants tonight.

steps.description: Create cold watch alert when overnight lows are risky

params.title: Wind advisory for ${resolved_location}
params.description: Forecast max wind ${forecast_wind_maxes[0]} mph reaches the wind alert threshold of ${wind_threshold_mph} mph for ${resolved_location}. ${forecast_day_names[0]} ${forecast_dates[0]} condition ${forecast_conditions[0]}. ${forecast_day_names[1]} ${forecast_dates[1]} max wind ${forecast_wind_maxes[1]} mph with ${forecast_conditions[1]}. Secure covers, trays, or lightweight materials if needed.

steps.description: Create wind alert when forecast gusts are elevated

params.title: Heat watch for ${resolved_location}
params.description: Forecast high ${forecast_highs[0]}F meets the heat watch threshold of ${heat_threshold_f}F for ${resolved_location}. ${forecast_day_names[0]} ${forecast_dates[0]} low ${forecast_lows[0]}F. ${forecast_day_names[1]} ${forecast_dates[1]} high ${forecast_highs[1]}F with low ${forecast_lows[1]}F. Plan watering and shade support if needed.

steps.description: Create heat alert when forecast highs are elevated

params.title: Severe weather watch for ${resolved_location}
params.description: Watched severe weather conditions are forecast for ${resolved_location}. ${forecast_day_names[0]} ${forecast_dates[0]} expects ${forecast_conditions[0]} with ${forecast_precip_probs[0]}% precipitation chance and max wind ${forecast_wind_maxes[0]} mph. ${forecast_day_names[1]} ${forecast_dates[1]} expects ${forecast_conditions[1]} with ${forecast_precip_probs[1]}% precipitation chance and max wind ${forecast_wind_maxes[1]} mph.

steps.description: Create severe weather alert for storms, hail, snow, or freezing rain

params.title: Workflows/Weather Watch/${date}

success_speech_llm_prompt: Give a short spoken summary for this weather watch. Keep it under 45 words. Mention the current weather in ${resolved_location}. If forecast lows and winds are available, mention tonight's low ${forecast_lows[0]}F and tomorrow's max wind ${forecast_wind_maxes[1]} mph. If forecast values are unavailable, say the extended forecast was unavailable. Mention that the full report is on canvas.
abort_speech: Couldn't complete the weather watch workflow.
